mode: read-only targeted scheduling diff review; no UI, production changes, test rerun or delegation
scope: Final worktree .github/workflows/swarm-flight.yml diff; downstream quality aggregator and its validation helper; supplied core failure log. No whole-repository audit.
conclusion: 合理并行拆分，保留原检查及失败门槛，没有延长单job时限或减少用例。新增migrations作为checks矩阵的一员，仍经整个矩阵verify和quality必需汇总约束。只能认可调度结构，实际是否在8分钟内完成须由新CI证实。

changes_observed.effect: core/regressions/samples仍保留；每个checks runner沿用官方Godot下载/校验和导入步骤；fail-fast:false不变。
pond_source_routes_verify/save_verify及rain_choice_verify/save_verify命令、QA目录、日志错误检查与0 failures检查原样保留。

changes_observed.change: wind migration and long-world particles becomes a separate core step
changes_observed.effect: wind_route_verify/save_verify与ellipse_precision_probe的原命令及守卫原样保留，补有同样set -euo pipefail和GODOT_BIN环境。

command_guard_comparison.method: HEAD/worktree Counter of exact stripped Godot invocations, QA-env invocations, Python/timeout commands, error grep and success grep lines
command_guard_comparison.meaning: 限定识别到的测试命令及守卫无丢失或替换；人工diff同时核查仅矩阵/条件/step边界变化。

budget.limits: 新增runner会另有启动/导入开销；此报告不把静态拆分当作新CI已通过或对所有后续耗时的保证。

required_coverage_chain.basis: verify: needs checks; if always(); CHECKS_RESULT=needs.checks.result; shell test =success
required_coverage_chain.coverage: checks的矩阵包含migrations；任何未成功矩阵结果不满足verify成功门槛。

required_coverage_chain.basis: swarm uses reusable swarm-flight.yml; required needs包含swarm并always运行；swarm-gate needs[scope,swarm]并always运行
required_coverage_chain.coverage: 两个上层汇总继续接收整个swarm reusable workflow结果，未单列只检查旧三个suite。

required_coverage_chain.basis: JOBS含swarm；scope选中时expected=success，与needs.swarm.result严格比较；缺失/失败/取消/意外跳过不通过
required_coverage_chain.coverage: selected swarm必须成功；这不更改scope原有选择规则。

failure_log_observation.observed: 日志显示pond model80/0、pond disk69/0、rain198/0、rain disk140/0、wind model79/0，随后wind disk启动，约38.6秒后operation canceled；未出现wind disk成功标记。
failure_log_observation.interpretation: 支持将已经串行占用时间的pond/rain迁出core；取消不能记wind测试通过，也不能仅据该日志断定wind行为失败。
failure_log_observation.scope_limit: 其余suite成功来自父任务说明，本定向审查未另读其日志。
